reviews.comment: He is very easy to understand.  Participation gets you significant extra credit. Exams are hard but graded generously.  He is very receptive of questions, in and out of class.  There were occasional attendance checks, but it's not smart to skip classes on a subject that hard anyway.  He's really good and made thermo as easy as possible.

Thermo is hard no matter what, but this guy made it easier by actually teaching the material and deriving the equations himself instead of just reading off the slides. Exams were a bit difficult but very fair in grading so if you do the HWs then the exams are easy. It was his first time teaching so some stuff were new to him but he tried his best.

He provides a lot of extra credit opportunities in class and outside of class (up to 10 points extra to final grade). The exams are reasonable. Homework can be somewhat time-consuming but not impossible. Required in-class quizzes are pre-announced, but there are a bunch of extra credit pop quizzes. Quizzes are conceptual based on powerpoint slides.
